Security / LinkedIn post

Fast, secure, and reconcilable belong together.

Combine authenticated APIs, controlled state changes, financial records, and operational evidence.

Brajkishor Pandey

Engineering leader · Fintech architect

Adapted from my LinkedIn writing and related technical material. Read original on LinkedIn ↗

A faster endpoint does not by itself create a dependable payment journey. My LinkedIn post connects speed with identity, duplicate protection, financial integrity, and reconciliation.

Make the boundaries explicit

Authenticate service requests, authorize the operation, and preserve the payment identifier across asynchronous processing. A repeated delivery should not repeat the financial effect.

Connect the outcome

Ledger records explain the financial event. Provider and bank evidence help establish what happened outside the platform. Reconciliation identifies missing, duplicated, mismatched, or unsettled items and gives exceptions an owner.

Observe the whole journey

The customer experience, provider attempt, financial posting, and settlement outcome need linked evidence. Speed is useful when the platform can also explain and control the result.
